item.title: Rakuten Offering 25,000 Amex/Bilt Points for New Chime Account
item.description: Rakuten has increased the offer for Chime. You can now earn $250 or 25,000 points when you go through the shopping portal to open a new Chime account. The post Rakuten Offering 25,000 Amex/Bilt Points for New Chime Account appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: IHG Flash Sale, Save 25% on Stays Through April
item.description: IHG has launched a new flash sale, offering 25% discount for IHG One Rewards members. You must book by February 26 for stays through the end of April. The post IHG Flash Sale, Save 25% on Stays Through April appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Free Movie Tickets and Popcorn for Visa Infinite Cardholders
item.description: If you have an eligible Visa Infinite credit card in your wallet, you can get two complimentary Regal movie tickets and one free popcorn. The post Free Movie Tickets and Popcorn for Visa Infinite Cardholders appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Improved Offers for Hilton Cards Coming Soon
item.description: American Express may soon bring back elevated welcome offers on Hilton Honors credit cards. The post Improved Offers for Hilton Cards Coming Soon appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: United TravelBank Purchases No Longer Triggering Amex Airline Incidental Credit?
item.description: The ability to use the American Express Platinum $200 airline incidental credit for United TravelBank purchases appears to have reached its end. The post United TravelBank Purchases No Longer Triggering Amex Airline Incidental Credit? appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Does Chase Blow Now More Than Ever?
item.description: These days, I feel like Chase credit cards and the bank itself are worse than I can ever remember. Thoughts are within. The post Does Chase Blow Now More Than Ever? appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Chase Offers: Spend $600 Through Chase Travel, Get $100 Credit
item.description: Chase has launched a new Chase Offer for Sapphire, Freedom, Ink, and J.P. Morgan Reserve cardholders, offering a $100 statement credit when they spend at least $600 on Chase Travel in a single transaction. The post Chase Offers: Spend $600 Through Chase Travel, Get $100 Credit appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Bank of America Making Big Changes in Preferred Rewards Rebrand
item.description: Bank of America has just announced a massive overhaul of its popular "Preferred Rewards" program. On or about May 26, 2026, the program will officially become BofA Rewards™. The post Bank of America Making Big Changes in Preferred Rewards Rebrand appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: IHG Adds Its 21st Brand, Noted Collection
item.description: InterContinental Hotels Group has officially launched its 21st brand, named the "Noted Collection". The post IHG Adds Its 21st Brand, Noted Collection appeared first on Miles to Memories.

item.title: Chase to Remove One Redemption Option for Credit Card Cashback
item.description: The credit card issuer soon stop allowing cashback to be redeemed as a deposit into an external bank account. The post Chase to Remove One Redemption Option for Credit Card Cashback appeared first on Miles to Memories.
